MonoBrowser Mobile 0.2.2

Start page
- Bookmarks on the start page: pick single bookmarks and whole folders (Bookmarks -> options -> "Show on the start page", "Edit" on the start page, or Settings -> Start page)
- Site icons instead of letters on the tiles, in greyscale by default (switch it off for colour); icons come only from pages you visit, nothing extra is downloaded, private tabs save none
- Your own background picture, from a photo on the device or from an address; it is copied into the app, so it works offline and after the original is gone; adjustable veil and greyscale

Address bar
- Swipe the bar sideways to switch tabs: the bar and the page follow your finger and the neighbouring tab slides in; swipe past the last tab for a new tab
- Pull the bar towards the page to slide in the tab list
- Choose what the bar shows and in what order (Settings -> Appearance -> Address bar layout): back, forward, reload, tab counter, new tab, bookmarks, add bookmark, share

Menu and settings
- Choose which entries the main menu shows and in what order (Settings -> Appearance -> Menu layout)
- Settings are grouped into categories; search still covers everything

Also
- New logo: launcher icon, splash screen, onboarding and About
- Tab previews in the tab list are in colour; only sleeping tabs stay grey

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.2.2.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. If Google Play Protect asks to scan the app, choose "Scan app". Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.2.2.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Updating from 0.2.1 keeps your tabs, bookmarks and settings; 0.2.1 also offers the update in the app.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.2.2.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.2.2.apk.sha256`)
